documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its new 10-acre automated Vadodara facility. Management reported strong financial growth for the quarter and full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing of textile binder and table glue. The company outlined plans to scale capacity utilization, expand non-textile binder applications, and increase the manufacturing revenue contribution mix to 50%. Furthermore, management discussed strategies regarding raw material cost volatility, working capital management, and debt reduction using internal cash accruals. Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited released its investor presentation for Q4 FY26, highlighting financial performance including revenue, EBITDA, and PAT figures alongside historical trends.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall EBITDA margins to increase by 2% to 3% as manufacturing scales up.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching 100% capacity utilization of the plant by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Management aims to increase the manufacturing contribution to 50% of the revenue mix.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

guidance.claim: The wood-coating segment revenue is expected to double, potentially growing from INR 6 crores to INR 12-14 crores.
guidance.quote: Plus, our distribution of business for wood-coating, the current contribution of 6%, the growth of that can also double. Meaning we can even take it from INR6 crores to INR12 crores, INR14 crores.

guidance.claim: Manufacturing margins can be expected to reach near about 50% according to the production in the coming time.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: At full utilization, the 500-ton capacity can generate a total turnover of around INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores from manufacturing.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

guidance.claim: Growth in the textile ink market is expected to be 15% to 20% and for the wood coating market 20% to 30%.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestically, management does not feel any significant risk or impact on growth at this stage.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestically, we don't feel any significant risk or impact on growth at this stage.

demand_outlook.claim: The company highlighted that the Indian textiles and apparel market is projected to reach US$ 350 billion by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: The market for Indian textiles and apparel is projected to grow at a 10% CAGR to reach US$ 350 billion by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market, particularly water-based and specialty formulations, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports by eliminating duties.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

capex_expansion.claim: New machinery will be added over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Future capacity expansion beyond the initial 500-ton capacity requires installing additional vessels costing INR 3 crores to INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production has commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The manufacturing facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process combined with advanced automation and zero carbon footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: The facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process combined with advanced automation and process controls, which ensuring consistent product quality and high throughput and zero carbon footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The plant is designed with utility, cooling plant, and monomer storage capacity installed according to expansion capacity so no more capex is required for further expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have remained volatile with raw materials seeing a sharp increase during the year due to global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: Proactive inventory strategy has helped secure raw materials at favorable blended costs to provide near-term margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: For the manufacturing segment, the gross margin is approximately 30% to 35% and EBITDA margins are around 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: And the gross margin is approx. 30%-35%. When we compare specifically for, comparison with manufacturing and trading business, we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin was reported at 33.2% for Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (%) 33.2% 39.0% -580 bps 25.0% 820 bps 28.2% 25.8% 240 bps

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 23.1%.
PAT margin for Q4 FY26 was reported at 11.9%.
Q3 revenue reached INR 33.54 crores, growing by 5.38% year-on-year, with EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR 7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: In quarter 3 financial year '26, the company reported a revenue of INR33.54 crores, growing by 5.38% year-on-year. On a quarter-on-quarter basis, revenue recorded a sharp 78.54% increase compared to the quarter 2 of the financial year '26. The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in Q3 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax rose by 117.4% to INR 4.06 crores with the PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax also showed strong growth, rising by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first 2 months of manufacturing (November and December), the plant utilized around 60% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the INR 33 crores revenue in Q3, 25% came from manufacturing and 75% from the trading business.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, out of this INR33 crores revenue in Q3, from the manufacturing we are getting 25% and rest of the 75% from the trading business.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is confident that working capital will not become a constraint in the near future due to good internal availability and cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are very confident working capital will not become a constraint at least in the near future.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt reduction will be managed effectively through strong internal cash accruals without worry.
capital_allocation.quote: So, from internal accruals only we will be able to manage it, will be able to do it very effectively. So, we're not very worried about the debt.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the manufacturing capex, INR 30 crores is a bank loan and INR 20 crores was funded through IPO to purchase land for INR 10 crores, with the rest from internal accruals and unsecured promoter loans.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: The expected payback period for the INR 40 crores investment in the manufacturing plant is around 4 to 5 years.
capital_allocation.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: As of December end, the net worth stood at around INR 42 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The conference call notes that forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainty and actual results may differ.
risks_headwinds.quote: The statements are not guarantees of future performance and involve risks and uncertainty.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: New machinery will be added over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

management_commitments.claim: Non-textile binder trials are ongoing, and management expects to share updates within a couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: The Indian textiles and apparel market is projected to grow at a 10% CAGR to reach US$ 350 billion by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: The market for Indian textiles and apparel is projected to grow at a 10% CAGR to reach US$ 350 billion by 2030.

management_commitments.claim: By next financial year, the company will achieve full capacity utilization of 500 tons per month.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: Within 1 to 2 years, trading and manufacturing revenues are expected to be equal at 50% each.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
